_comment: The GRx models of Wiki-GRx-Models this provider knows, per robot: 'dir' (the model directory under GRX/ of the repository) and 'entries' (a short name for each model file, relative to 'dir'). The first entry is the default. Models with the Fourier six-degree-of-freedom hand are not listed: their finger joints have no effort limits and are coupled by mimic joints that MuJoCo does not read.
